{{Quote|I am sending you to the Mustafar system in the Outer Rim.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Mustafar system''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]], around which orbited five [[Planet/Legends|planets]],<ref name="TEA" /> including [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]], [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]].
